These observed cash-timing and transaction-income channels support high forward value-estimation uncertainty, even though the FY2025 profit/cash observations and corrected NCI are available.
disconfirmingEvidence: FY2025 reported revenue, group profit and CFO are positive; the final year cash recovery is real evidence against treating the prior negative CFO as a permanent loss.
